strings.meta.title: pdff — Hlanganisa, shintsha futhu uhlela i-PDF, Word, Excel mahhala
strings.meta.description: Litulusi lamahhala ku-inthanethi lekuhlanganisa, kuguqula, kucindezela, kwehlukanisa futhu kuvikela amafayela akho e-PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint kanye nemifanekiso. Kute kubhaliswa, amafayela asuswa ngekushesha.
strings.meta.keywords: hlanganisa i-pdf, shintsha i-pdf, i-pdf ibe yi-word, i-word ibe yi-pdf, i-jpg ibe yi-pdf, i-pdf ibe yi-jpg, cindezela i-pdf, yehlukanisa i-pdf, i-excel ibe yi-pdf, matulusi e-pdf amahhala
strings.footer.text: Mahhala, kute kubhaliswa. Amafayela akho asuswa ngekushesha lapho sekugetiwe.

strings.home.steps[0].text: Hudula amafayela akho noma uwakhetse ocingweni lwakho.
strings.home.steps[1].title: Khetsa
strings.home.steps[1].text: Bekisa luhlelo, ifomethi lephumako noma emakhasi lokumele agcinwe.

strings.home.steps[2].text: Umphumela uyadawuniloda ngawo kwakha, sewulungele kutfunyelwa.

strings.workspace.dropAny: I-PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, imifanekiso, EPUB, umbhalo…
strings.workspace.approximate: Kusuka ku-PDF, sakhiwo siyaphindvwa sakhiwe: umphumela ungadzingo kutsi utfolwe kabusha, ikakhulu ngemibhalo lekhishwe ngesikrini.

strings.workspace.targetNone: Lawamafayela kute ifomethi lenelefana nayo lephumako.
strings.workspace.limits: Kuze kufike emakhasini angu-{pages} kanye namafayela angu-{files} ngemsebenti munye.
strings.language.title: Khetsa lulwimi
strings.language.unavailable: Inchazelo letikhombisako ayikavulwa kuleseva okwamanje: i-pdff ikhombiswa ngesiNgisi.
strings.language.failed: Kuhumusha kuba ngu-{lang} kwehlulekile. Ncedza uzame futhu emva kwesikhatsi.
strings.seo.why[0].title: 100% mahhala
strings.seo.why[0].text: Kute kubhaliselwa, kute likhadi le-credit, kute uphawu lolungeziwe embhalweni wakho.
strings.seo.why[1].title: Kute kubhaliswa
strings.seo.why[1].text: Kute i-akhawunti lekumele ivulwe: vula likhasi, faka amafayela akho, kuphelile.
strings.seo.why[2].title: Amafayela akho ahlala ngemicondo yakho
strings.seo.why[2].text: Ayasebentiswa, bese asuswa ngekushesha. Asigcini imibhalo yakho noma imininingwane yakho.
strings.seo.why[3].title: Onkhe emafomethi
strings.seo.why[3].text: I-PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, imifanekiso, EPUB… kusuka kukhompyutha noma ocingweni.
strings.seo.faq[0].a: Yebo. Onkhe matulusi amahhala, kute uphawu futhu kute lokuboshwe ngemuva kwekubhalisela. Kute likhadi le-credit lecelwako.
strings.seo.faq[1].a: Cha. Kute kubhaliswa, kute i-email: usebentisa amatulusi ngekushesha.
strings.seo.faq[2].a: Cha. Amafayela akho asebentela kuphela umsebenti lowucelile, bese asuswa. Akekho loyifundzako futhu ayisoze yabelwa.
strings.seo.faq[3].a: Yebo. I-pdff isebenta esipheqululini sanoma ngumuphi umakhalekhukhwini, ithebhulethi noma ikhompyutha (Android, iPhone, Windows, Mac, Linux), kute lokumele kufakwe.
strings.seo.faq[4].a: I-PDF, Word (DOCX, DOC), Excel (XLSX, XLS, CSV), PowerPoint (PPTX, PPT), OpenDocument (ODT, ODS, ODP), RTF, imifanekiso (JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF, GIF, SVG), EPUB, TXT, HTML nalokunye.
strings.seo.faq[5].a: Ungasebenta ngamafayela angu-{files} ngesikhatsi sinye, futhu umbhalo lophumako ungaba nemakhasa angu-{pages}.
strings.privacy.title: Kuyimfihlo
strings.privacy.description: Indlela i-pdff lephatsa ngayo amafayela akho: kute i-akhawunti, kute umbhalo longetehlukaniswa, kute tikhangiso kute nekuthengiswa kwemininingwane.
strings.privacy.intro: I-pdff yakhiwe kuze kube sekutsi imibhalo yakho ihlale iyeyakho. Nazi, ngemavi alula, tintfo letentekako nawusebentisa.
strings.privacy.sections[0].title: Amafayela akho
strings.privacy.sections[0].text: Atfunyelwa ngekufihliwe (HTTPS), ayasebentiswa, bese asuswa ngekushesha nakuba umphumela usulungele. Amafayela lamakhulu adlula endzaweni yesikhashana ngeligama lelingabonakali futhu asuswa ngekushesha nakusebenta kuphela; kuhlanza lokuzitjelako kususa konkhe lokungase kusale kungakapheli ema-awa angu-24.
strings.privacy.sections[1].title: Kute i-akhawunti, kute imininingwane yakho
strings.privacy.sections[1].text: I-pdff ayifuni kubhaliswa, ayifuni i-email kute akukho likhadi le-credit lecelwako. Imibhalo yakho ayisadze ifundvwe, ihlatiywe, yabelwe noma isetjentiswe kucinisa inhlakanipho yekungenisa (AI).
strings.privacy.sections[2].title: Kulinganiswa kwekuhanjelwa
strings.privacy.sections[2].text: Sibala kuvakashelwa ngaphandle kwekuveza ligama nangaphandle kwemacookies (Vercel Web Analytics) kuze sifundze kutsi yimaphi amatulusi lasusako. Kute tikhangiso, kute kulandzelelwa emkhatsini wemasayithi.
strings.privacy.sections[3].title: Emacookies
strings.privacy.sections[3].text: I-cookie yinye nje, lezingaba khona noma ingabi khona: ikhumbula lulwimi loluletfule.
strings.privacy.sections[4].title: Kusingatfwa
strings.privacy.sections[4].text: Indzawo isingatfwa yi-Vercel kuseva eParis; kushintshwa kwe-Word, Excel ne-PowerPoint kuyaphatfwa yi-Render eFrankfurt. Labaphakeli baphatsa amafayela kuphela ngesikhatsi sekushintshwa.
strings.privacy.sections[5].title: Kutfintsana
strings.privacy.sections[5].text: Unembuzo noma umbono? Sifike kusuka ekhasini lephrojekthi:
strings.tools.fusionner.name: Hlanganisa
strings.tools.fusionner.tagline: Hlanganisa amafayela lamanyenti (PDF, Word, imifanekiso…) abe yi-PDF yinye, ngeluhlelo loluletfule.
strings.tools.fusionner.seoTitle: Hlanganisa amafayela e-PDF ku-inthanethi mahhala (Word, imifanekiso, PDF)
strings.tools.fusionner.seoDescription: Hlanganisa i-PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint nemifanekiso ibe yi-PDF yinye, ngeluhlelo loluletfule. Mahhala, kute kubhaliswa, kute uphawu, amafayela asuswa ngekushesha.
strings.tools.fusionner.intro: Faka onkhe emaphepha akho efayelini linye: i-pdff yemukela ama-PDF kodvwa iphindze yemukele nemibhalo ye-Word, tishidi te-Excel, tinkulumo nemifanekiso, ibihlanganise ibe yi-PDF lecocisekile lenophawu lwelibhakha ngefileyinye.
strings.tools.fusionner.options.bookmarks.label: Engetela uphawu lwelibhakha lunye ngelifayela linye
strings.tools.convertir.name: Shintsha
strings.tools.convertir.tagline: Shintsha noma ngumuphi umbhalo noma umfanekiso ube ngulolunye ifomethi.
strings.tools.convertir.seoTitle: Shintsha i-PDF ibe yi-Word, Word ibe yi-PDF, JPG ibe yi-PDF — mahhala
strings.tools.convertir.seoDescription: Siguquli samahhala: PDF ↔ Word, Excel, PowerPoint, JPG, PNG, EPUB namafomethi angu-40+. Ku-inthanethi, kute kubhaliswa, sezingeni lelisetulu.
strings.tools.convertir.intro: Siguquli sinye sawo wonkhe amafomethi: Word ibe yi-PDF, PDF ibe yi-Word, JPG ibe yi-PDF, PDF ibe yi-JPG, Excel ibe yi-PDF, PowerPoint ibe yi-PDF, PNG ibe yi-JPG, EPUB ibe yi-PDF… Faka amafayela akho bese i-pdff inikela kuphela ngemafomethi lasebenthako.

strings.tools.diviser.name: Yehlukanisa
strings.tools.diviser.tagline: Yehlukanisa i-PDF ibe ngamafayela lamanyenti: ngemikhawulo yemakhasimende noma likhasi ngelikhasi.
strings.tools.diviser.seoTitle: Yehlukanisa i-PDF ku-inthanethi mahhala — hlukanisa emakhasimende
strings.tools.diviser.seoDescription: Yehlukanisa i-PDF ibe ngamafayela lamanyenti: ngemikhawulo yemakhasimende, likhasi ngelikhasi noma onkhe emakhasi angu-N. Mahhala, kuyashesha kute kubhaliswa.
strings.tools.diviser.intro: Tfuma kuphela incenye yembhalo lomkhulu lebulekile: i-pdff isika i-PDF yakho ngemikhawulo lokhetsako bese ibuyisela tincenye ku-ZIP.

strings.tools.diviser.options.ranges.label: Emikhawulo
strings.tools.diviser.options.every.label: Emakhasi ngelifayela
strings.tools.extraire.name: Khipha / susa emakhasi
strings.tools.extraire.tagline: Gcina noma susa emakhasi latsite e-PDF.
strings.tools.extraire.seoTitle: Khipha noma susa emakhasi ku-PDF — mahhala
strings.tools.extraire.seoDescription: Gcina kuphela emakhasi lowadingako ku-PDF, noma susa lawongeziwe. Ku-inthanethi, mahhala, kute kubhaliswa, kute uphawu.
strings.tools.extraire.intro: Likhasi lelize, sisonge lesingasasebenti, kuphindvwa? Bhala emakhasi lokumele agcinwe noma asuswe (ngebunye 1-3, 7, 10-end) uthole i-PDF lecocekile ngemizuzwana.

strings.tools.extraire.options.pages.label: Emakhasi
strings.tools.organiser.name: Hlela kabusha emakhasi
strings.tools.organiser.seoTitle: Hlela kabusha emakhasi e-PDF ku-inthanethi — mahhala
strings.tools.organiser.seoDescription: Shintsha luhlelo lwemakhasimende e-PDF, phindvula lentsandvo noma phendvula umbhalo wonkhe. Mahhala, ku-inthanethi, kute kubhaliswa.
strings.tools.organiser.intro: Emakhasi akhishwe angahlelekile? Bhala luhlelo lolusha (ngebunye 3, 1, 2, 4-end) noma phendvula umbhalo wonkhe: i-pdff iyenta lokusele.
strings.tools.organiser.options.order.label: Luhlelo lolusha
strings.tools.organiser.options.reverse.label: Phendvula umbhalo wonkhe (ayinaki luhlelo lolungenhla)
strings.tools.pivoter.name: Jikisa
strings.tools.pivoter.seoDescription: Jikisa onkhe emakhasi e-PDF noma lawitsite, nge-90°, 180° noma 270°. Mahhala, kuyashesha, kute kubhaliswa.
strings.tools.pivoter.intro: Kukhipha lokuphendvukile noma likhasi lasendleleni? Jikisa umbhalo wonkhe noma kuphela emakhasi lowakhetsako, ngaphandle kwekulahlekelwa izinga.

strings.tools.numeroter.seoDescription: Engetela tinombolo temakhasimende ku-PDF: khetsa indzawo, ifomethi "1 / 10", inombolo yekucala kanye nebukhulu. Mahhala, kute kubhaliswa.
strings.tools.numeroter.intro: Kulungele sidzingo, ifayela lekucela noma umbiko: khetsa indzawo, ifomethi nenombolo yekucala, futhu i-pdff inika tinombolo emakhasi akho kahle.

strings.tools.compresser.seoTitle: Cindezela i-PDF ku-inthanethi — yehlisa ubukhulu befayela mahhala
strings.tools.compresser.seoDescription: Nciphisa i-PDF kuze uyitfumele nge-imeyili noma uyifake kusayithi luhulumende. Amazinga lamatsatfu ekucindezela, mahhala.
strings.tools.compresser.intro: Iposi liyenqaba ifayela lakho ngoba linsima kakhulu? Cindezela i-PDF yakho kantsi ugcina umbhalo ucacile: khetsa lokulungele, lokunconyiwe noma lokucinile kuye ngemaphasi lowadzingako.

strings.tools.proteger.seoDescription: Fihla i-PDF ngephasiwedi (AES-256) uvale kuprinta, kukopa noma kuhlela. Mahhala, kute kubhaliswa.
strings.tools.proteger.intro: Ngaphambi kwekutfumela umvuzo noma umbhalo wetempilo, yivale ngephasiwedi lecinile: ngaphandle kwayo, akekho longayivula.

strings.tools.deverrouiller.tagline: Susa iphasiwedi ku-PDF olewati iphasiwedi yayo.
strings.tools.deverrouiller.seoDescription: Susa iphasiwedi ku-PDF lowati iphasiwedi yayo, kuze uyivule, uyiprinte noma uyihlanganise ngokukhululeka. Mahhala.
strings.tools.deverrouiller.intro: Wati iphasiwedi, kodvwa kuyacina ukuyibhala ngato tonkhe tikhatsi? Iyisuse kanye kuphela. I-pdff ayisoze yeqa iphasiwedi ongayati.
strings.tools.deverrouiller.options.password.hel: Shiya kungagcwalisiwe uma i-PDF inemaphasiwedi etimvume kuphela.
